label: M7.2 foreshock San Felipe
description: Magnitude 7.2 shallow foreshock near San Felipe, Yaracuy, 22 km depth, 24 June 2026.

label: M7.5 mainshock Yumare
description: Magnitude 7.5 shallow mainshock near Yumare, Veroes, Yaracuy, 10 km depth, 39-40s after foreshock.

label: Extensive aftershock sequence
description: Over 1,000 aftershocks recorded by mid-July, including M5.1 Tucacas and M4.4 Guatire events, continuing to weaken structures.

label: Landslide/debris-flow risk from rains
description: Onset of rainy season, hurricanes or tropical lows could trigger landslides and mud flows on seismically weakened slopes in North Coastal Range.

label: Risk of disease outbreaks
description: PAHO identified elevated risk of measles, diphtheria, pertussis, polio, acute diarrheal disease, cholera and vector-borne illness linked to displacement and damaged WASH.

label: Deaths from earthquakes
description: Death toll rose from 32 to over 5,200 across successive reports (DFS, OCHA, UNHCR, UNFPA, UNICEF, CESVI).

label: Injuries from earthquakes
description: Injuries rose from about 700 to over 16,700 across multiple situation reports.

label: Tens of thousands missing
description: IFRC noted tens of thousands reported missing, with ambiguous unreconciled figures across sources.

label: Mass displacement/homelessness
description: Displacement estimates rose from 3,000 (OCHA) to over 17,900 homeless (UNICEF/CESVI) with people in temporary camps.

label: Collapsed/damaged buildings
description: 2,501 damaged sites including 774 housing units, 189 fully collapsed, and 38 hospitals (UNHCR); CESVI cites 856 affected buildings.

label: US$6.7-37 billion economic damage
description: UNDP preliminary estimate of $6.7bn direct physical damage; UNDRR analytical estimate of ~$37bn total direct damage to buildings and infrastructure.

label: Critical infrastructure disruption
description: Closure of Maiquetía airport, suspension of Caracas Metro/railways, power outages, damage to water, telecoms, roads and bridges.

label: Overwhelmed health system
description: Hospitals managing large trauma caseloads within an already weakened health system with pre-crisis shortages of supplies and surgical capacity.

label: Loss of livelihoods/income
description: Households lost homes, productive assets, employment; small businesses, informal commerce and tourism severely disrupted (IFRC).

label: Heightened protection risks
description: Overcrowded shelters, family separation and displacement increased GBV and protection risks especially for women, girls, disabled and older persons (UNFPA).

label: Logistics congestion at ports/airport
description: Damaged Maiquetía airport and concentration of operations at Port of La Guaira increased risk of delays in receipt, storage and distribution of supplies.

label: Unreinforced/informal construction
description: Most buildings unlikely built to modern earthquake regulations; lack of enforcement of building standards; informal settlements on unstable hillsides.

label: Protracted economic/humanitarian crisis
description: Venezuela ranked 24th/97 on INFORM Severity Index (7.6/10), nearly 8 million already in humanitarian need before the quakes.

label: High poverty/multidimensional poverty
description: 94% poverty rate and 46% multidimensional poverty in La Guaira; over half population in extreme poverty nationally before quakes.

label: Weak pre-existing shelter/WASH/health systems
description: REACH/ACAPS found weak shelter, water and health systems in Aragua, La Guaira, Carabobo, Falcón limiting absorptive capacity before the quakes.

label: Fragile housing stock
description: 62% of housing in fragile condition with repair needs in La Guaira; widespread housing deterioration reported pre-quake.

label: Workforce gaps from emigration
description: Years of emigration (~8 million people) left critical workforce gaps impacting search-and-rescue and recovery capacity (IRC).

label: Low Protection Cluster coverage
description: Protection Cluster had reached only 8% of its 1.9 million target population by April 2026.

label: Censorship/limited transparency
description: Censorship, limited transparency and restrictions on media/civil society weakened public trust in official information (ACAPS/Amnesty International).

label: Pre-crisis weak health system
description: Public health system in protracted collapse with shortages of personnel, medicines, supplies and surgical capacity before the quakes.

label: Need for safe temporary shelter
description: Health Cluster identified critical need for safe temporary shelter amid families sleeping in streets, cars and makeshift tents.

label: Need for safe water and sanitation
description: Water cited as top priority need nationally since March 2026; WASH gaps worsened post-quake per Health Cluster and Project HOPE.

label: Need for specialized medical personnel/supplies
description: Need for logistics support, specialized medical personnel, medicines and equipment flagged by Health Cluster and PAHO.

label: Need for mental health/psychosocial support
description: Critical need for specialized MHPSS amid widespread fear, grief and distress; Project HOPE found significant MHPSS gaps.

label: Need for child protection pathways
description: Need to activate protection pathways for unaccompanied children identified in health centers.

label: Need for SRH and GBV services
description: UNFPA flagged unmet needs in survivor-centred GBV and SRH services amid overcrowded shelters and family separation.

label: Need for structural safety assessment
description: Risk that buildings not collapsed sustained unseen structural damage, requiring assessment before safe return (ACAPS).

label: Need for logistics coordination
description: OCHA Logistics Working Group identified need for coordination given congestion at airport/port, fuel shortages and access constraints.

label: Need for livelihoods/economic investment
description: IRC warned urgent investment in local economies and livelihoods is needed to prevent deepening crisis in early recovery window.

label: Need for landslide/rainfall monitoring
description: Shelter Cluster recommended daily monitoring of rainfall/landslide risk and landslide/debris-flow mapping in North Coastal Range.

label: Need for vaccine supply security
description: PAHO identified need to restore routine immunization services, cold chain and vaccine supply given outbreak risk.

label: Need for casualty registration/tracking
description: PAHO noted persistent gaps in registration and follow-up of injured/hospitalized patients causing underestimation of casualties.

label: Search and rescue operations
description: Venezuelan Red Cross and international UNDAC/USAR teams under INSARAG conducted search and rescue from 24-25 June.

label: National state of emergency declared
description: Government declared national state of emergency and designated La Guaira a disaster zone.

label: Temporary access restrictions La Guaira
description: Authorities imposed temporary access restrictions to La Guaira state from night of 26 June to prioritize search and rescue.

label: Expanded Health Cluster activation
description: Expanded Health Cluster co-led with MPPS activated 26 June to consolidate single response mechanism integrating state, UN and NGO actors.

label: IFRC DREF and Emergency Appeal
description: IFRC allocated CHF 2 million DREF and launched CHF 50-55 million Emergency Appeal targeting 300,000 people.

label: Field hospital and operations centre
description: Venezuelan Red Cross set up field hospital at Jorge García Carmeiro Stadium and a Field Operations Centre.

label: UNHCR protection and shelter support
description: UNHCR seeking $14.8-14.85M to support 30,000 people with protection, core relief items and shelter, including multi-service centres.

label: UNFPA SRH/GBV response scale-up
description: UNFPA scaling up life-saving SRH and GBV prevention/response services targeting 64,000-230,000 people.

label: UNICEF earthquake response appeal
description: UNICEF requested $65.7M to reach 470,000 people including 167,000 children, addressing health, WASH, protection and education needs.

label: NGO emergency relief mobilization
description: MSF, Good Neighbors, CESVI, Project HOPE/Proyecto Esperanza and Turkish Red Crescent mobilized relief, health posts and needs assessments.

label: OCHA Logistics Working Group services
description: LWG provides shared logistics services, transport, storage and information on access conditions, with $0.8M budget.

label: PAHO/WHO medical supply delivery
description: PAHO/WHO delivered medical supplies and equipment including to Maternal and Child Hospital Leopoldo Aguerrevere.

label: Rapid needs assessments
description: UNDAC, REACH, Project HOPE and other partners conducted rapid needs assessments of health, shelter and WASH conditions.

label: HRP Addendum and sector planning
description: OCHA Humanitarian Response Plan Addendum and UNICEF HAC Appeal Addendum outline sector plans targeting 1.3 million affected people across 7 states.

label: Health facility rehabilitation
description: Rehabilitation planning and restoration of ICU/maternity capacity at Hospital Dr. José Gregorio Hernández underway by 12 August.

label: PAHO Revolving Fund credit line
description: USD 18 million PAHO Revolving Fund credit line to support national vaccine supply security.

label: Environmental guidance for shelter response
description: Shelter Cluster/UNHCR recommended Sphere Standard 7 and ECHO Minimum Environmental Requirements for shelter siting, debris reuse and waste management.

label: Daily rainfall/landslide monitoring
description: Recommended daily monitoring of rainfall and landslide risk, plus landslide/debris-flow mapping in North Coastal Range.

label: Caribbean tsunami advisory
description: A brief Caribbean tsunami advisory was issued and cancelled within about an hour, indicating some monitoring capacity was operational.

label: Livelihoods/economic recovery investment
description: IRC recommends urgent investment in local economies and livelihood support during early recovery window.

label: Building code enforcement (lacking)
description: ACAPS notes lack of enforcement of building standards; no retrofitting or land-use planning programmes described prior to the event.

label: Venezuelan Red Cross
description: National Red Cross society conducting SAR, health posts and receiving DREF funding.

label: IFRC
description: International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies supporting Venezuelan Red Cross with funding and appeals.

label: UNHCR
description: UN Refugee Agency scaling up protection and shelter response.

label: UNFPA
description: UN Population Fund scaling up SRH and GBV response.

label: UNICEF
description: UN Children's Fund providing child-focused humanitarian response.

label: PAHO/WHO
description: Pan American Health Organization/WHO co-leading Health Cluster and providing medical supplies.

label: OCHA
description: UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs coordinating situation reports and logistics working group.

label: UNDP
description: UN Development Programme conducted RAPIDA damage assessment.

label: Shelter Cluster/UNHCR
description: Shelter Cluster co-led by UNHCR issuing environmental guidance and shelter standards.

label: International NGOs (MSF, CESVI, Project HOPE, Good Neighbors, Turkish Red Crescent)
description: International NGOs providing emergency relief, health services and needs assessments.

label: IRC
description: International Rescue Committee warning on economic recovery needs.
